name: Jebus Cross
description:
Jebus Cross Plus - a modified version of Jebus Cross template with following changes:

1) Optimized treasure density in all zones.
2) Limit of Dragon Utopias in the starting zone set to 3.
3) Gremlinhold and Bog Hermit objects added on Snow and Swamp terrains, respectively, in order to buff factions with strong terrain penalties.

Gremlinhold - guarded by 80/160/240 Master Gremlins. Gives 4/8/12 Archmagi as reward.

Bog Hermit - visiting hero is granted no terrain penalty on Swamp until the end of the week.

Recommended settings:

Size: XL
Players: 2
Monsters: strong
Roads: fast
Water: none
Difficulty: 160%
Simultaneous turns: 116
Timer: 12-6-2
Restarts: 2x111/1x112
author: wnukos, Grossmaster (graphics), MDT (graphics)
